payload.core_mechanism_summary: Verify last painter color exists and painters suffice per needed color. Greedily assign each painter to a mismatched plank of same color if possible, else to last painter's plank.
payload.rationale: The solution greedily assigns painters to planks needing that color, using the last painter as catch-all. This is a constructive greedy approach typical of exchange argument problems, where local choices are made without backtracking.
